questions.text:
What is printed?

x = 5
x = x + 3
print(x)
questions.explanation: The right-hand side is worked out first, so x becomes 5 + 3.

questions.text: Which of these is a valid variable name in Python?
questions.explanation: A name cannot start with a digit or contain a space, and class is reserved.
Writing a decimal point makes it a float, even when the value is whole.
range stops one before the second number.
range(3) gives 0, 1 and 2, which is three passes.

questions.text: Which keyword leaves a loop straight away?
questions.explanation: break exits the loop; continue only skips to the next pass.
len counts the items, and there are three.
Positions start at 0, so [0] is the first item.

questions.text: Which method adds one item to the end of a list?
questions.explanation: append adds a single item; extend adds every item of another list.
